transfer_from_invoked.meaning: a transferFrom(from, to, amount) call is executed on TokenWrapper using an allowance

event_from_address.meaning: the from address recorded in the emitted Transfer event

holder_address.meaning: the token holder whose balance decreases, i.e. the from parameter of transferFrom

explorer_shows_operator_as_sender.meaning: block explorers and wallets display the operator/router contract rather than the token holder as the sender of the TokenWrapper transfer, so the holder's sent-transactions list omits the transfer

assumptions: The spender is a legitimate allowance-based caller; the report does not claim unauthorized access.
Internal on-chain balances and accounting are updated correctly; the defect is confined to the emitted from address.

unresolved.description: Report does not supply concrete addresses or amounts; the correspondence is stated generically for every transferFrom call, so symbols remain symbolic.

limitations: The off-chain explorer/wallet display outcome is a potential downstream effect; it is represented by a grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric definition.
Only the i_explorer_wallet_history_wrong impact is formalized here; other listed impacts are out of scope for this plan.
